jobs.title: Recycling & Recyclability Engineer
jobs.description:
Logoplaste is currently seeking to recruit an Recycling & Recyclability Engineer reporting directly to the Recycling Consultant you will be required to work as an integral part of the team.

If you fit the profile, please submit your CV. This Recruitment process is confidential.

Logoplaste:

Present in 16 countries, Logoplaste is a global value-added service provider and producer of rigid plastic packaging for well-known fast moving consumer goods companies in the food and beverage, cosmetics, personal care and household industries. We are experts in manufacturing sustainable plastic packaging through embedded, just-in-time supply chains. Our Wall to Wall business model eliminates the need for secondary packaging and the logistics associated with transporting empty bottles. We've been reducing CO2 emissions since 1976. Logoplaste goes beyond expectations turning rigid plastic packaging’s impact on the planet into a net positive for the environment and business.

Who we are & What we do  
Logoplaste Innovation Lab (iLAB) team is at the forefront of sustainable packaging, driving projects that shape the future of our industry. iLab supports all phases of packaging development, from research, design and engineering to full industrial implementation, merging groundbreaking Design & Biomimicry Thinking with top class packaging engineering.

Job Summary

The Recycling & Recyclability Engineer is responsible for supporting the development, assessment, and optimization of plastic packaging solutions to meet recyclability, recycled content, circular economy, and regulatory requirements. The role contributes to innovation projects, customer technical support, packaging sustainability assessments, and certification activities by applying engineering, polymer science, and recycling expertises through laboratory testing, material characterization, recycling studies, regulatory assessments, and interactions with external laboratories, customers, certification bodies, recyclers, and industry associations.

Key Tasks & Activities...

* Conduct recyclability evaluations and recyclability protocol testing.
* Identify recyclability risks and improvement opportunities.
* Evaluate suitability of recycled polymers for packaging applications.
* Support qualification of rPET, rHDPE and rPP suppliers.
* Participate in recycled content optimization and certification projects.
* Perform plan and interpret laboratory testing - Coordinate testing with internal and external laboratories.
* Support root-cause investigations related to recycling and material quality.
* Monitor development of legislation and packaging and recycling industry trends.

Who we are looking for...

Background & Experience:

* Degree in Chemical or Materials Engineer with specification in Polymers
* Experience with laboratory equipment such as DSC, FTIR, Gas Chromatography, or similar techniques

Technical Skill

* Fluent in English
* MS Office with Advanced Excel
* Interest in plastics, recycling, and sustainable packaging
* Basic understanding of polymer materials and recycling processes
* Laboratory testing and data analysis skills
* Ability to interpret technical results and draw conclusions
* Knowledge of sustainability and circular economy concept

Interpersonal Skills

* Eager to learn and explore new technologies, materials, and sustainability trends.
* Enjoys working with data, testing results, and solving technical challenges.
* Takes a practical approach to identifying issues and finding solutions.
* Able to explain technical topics clearly and build positive working relationships.
* Delivers accurate work and maintains high quality standards.
* Takes initiative, follows through on commitments, and looks for opportunities to contribute.

Logoplaste is committed to creating a workplace where you feel welcomed and cared for. Where you can grow as a professional and as a person. Where you have access to resources and knowledge. Where respect and integrity guide all interactions and behaviors. Where your success depends on your performance, approach and mindset.

Follow us on LinkedIn

LOGOPLASTE

Shaping a better world with our partners through mindful packaging solutions

jobs.title: .NET Developer
Backend Software Developer
jobs.description:
Gostas de tecnologia e de resolver problemas complexos e desafiantes com uma equipa ágil? Então este anúncio é para ti!

Ao trabalhar na Create IT, vais estar envolvido em todas as fases de um projeto desde a proposta e análise, passando pela conceção, implementação e aceitação. Valorizamos pessoas curiosas e comunicativas, com boa capacidade de trabalhar em equipa, vontade de aprender e gosto por ensinar. A Create é uma empresa diferente, somos como uma família e os nossos valores refletem-se em toda a organização.

Valorizamos as pessoas, acima de tudo.

**Qualificações**

Relaxa! Não existe um candidato ideal para o que procuramos. Aqui prezamos a individualidade. Temos uma cultura muito forte mas somos uma equipa bastante heterogénea! A lista que se segue, NÃO é uma checklist obrigatória! São aspetos que valorizamos para o perfil que procuramos:

* Licenciatura ou Mestrado em Engenharia Informática (ou semelhante) ou experiência equivalente;
* Ser uma pessoa curiosa, com uma grande vontade de aprender;
* Conhecimentos dos princípios da engenharia de software, algoritmos, estruturas de dados e programação OO;
* Apetência e gosto pela área de sistemas distribuídos;
* Paixão por analisar e resolver problemas técnicos complexos;
* Experiência mínima de 3 anos em desenvolvimento de software nas seguintes tecnologias: .Net framework, SQL Server , Windows Forms ou ASP.Net e WCF
* Valorizamos se tiveres já experiência em: .Net Core, Desenvolvimento em Azure e NoSQL e micro-serviços.

**Perks**

Na Create vais encontrar:

Remuneração Justa & Benefícios Extra: Reconhecemos os teus esforços para nos ajudar a crescer.

Benefícios de Saúde e Bem-Estar: Cobertura médica, dentária e oftalmológica abrangente.

Ambiente de Trabalho Flexível: Opções de trabalho remoto e horários flexíveis para equilibrar a vida profissional e pessoal.

Crescimento Profissional: Opções de formação contínua, como cursos, workshops e certificações.

Atividades de Team-Building: Eventos e saídas regulares para promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e divertido.

Fora do Escritório: Encontro anual de negócios de 3 dias.

Zona de Jogos: Se preferes matraquilhos, jogos de arcada, Nintendo Switch ou outra coisa qualquer, adoramos ver o teu espírito competitivo em ação!

Tecnologia de Ponta: Acesso às mais recentes ferramentas e recursos para te destacar na tua função.

Trabalho Impactante: Faz parte de projetos aliciantes de modernização aplicacional focados no incremento de valor para o negócio dos nossos clientes.

Dias de Descanso Adicionais: Aproveita dois dias de descanso extra (Carnaval e uma ponte ou dia de aniversário).

Tipo de oferta: Período Integral

Benefícios:

* Cartão/Ticket refeição
* Seguro saúde

Localização do trabalho: Trabalho remoto híbrido em Lisboa

jobs.title: Domain Engineer
jobs.description:
**Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.**  
  
Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.  
  
**Part of something bigger**  
Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.  
Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.  
We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.  
  
**Your hiring experience matters**  
Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.  
If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

**The ERP Engineering Team at Shine**
-------------------------------------

We're a fast-growing engineering team on a mission to build the best ERP for Small Businesses in Europe. We work in a domain-based structure, where each domain has real ownership over its area — from architecture to quality and technical roadmap.

**Your Role as a Domain Engineer**
----------------------------------

As a Domain Engineer, you're the technical reference for the product: you define architecture direction, ensure engineering standards, and work closely with team managers and Senior Engineers to make sure technical decisions serve the business goals. This is a senior IC role, focused on cross-cutting technical impact, not people management.  
We're modernizing our stack and expanding into new markets, which means real problems around scale, multi-tenancy, and domain complexity — not greenfield, but not paralyzing legacy either.  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the target architecture of your domain and the realistic path to get there.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, security, and compliance are design constraints from day one, not afterthoughts.
* Maintain living architecture documentation (C4 model diagrams, ADRs) as part of the engineering workflow.
* Set and calibrate design review thresholds, delegating to senior engineers as their judgment grows.
* Spend roughly half your time embedded with engineering teams, and half on cross-engineering work — standards, the Golden Path, and the Architecture Forum.
* Grow the architectural judgment of senior engineers, so fewer decisions need to come through you over time.
* Partner with Engineering Directors, Engineering Managers, and Product to surface technical constraints and trade-offs with clarity.

**Job located in Porto with possibility of two remote working days per week.**

**About you**
-------------

* **Scalable systems experience:** You have significant hands-on experience designing and evolving systems at scale, ideally within multi-tenant SaaS or platform environments.
* **Architectural ownership:** You take end-to-end ownership of architecture decisions. You ensure your reasoning is well-documented so others can easily understand the context and trade-offs later.
* **Influence without authority:** You are comfortable operating with technical authority and guiding direction without needing formal line-management authority.
* **Cross-functional communication:** You can translate complex technical trade-offs into clear, legible concepts for Product managers and business leadership.
* **Empowerment over centralization:** You have a genuine interest in developing other engineers' judgment rather than centralizing decision-making around yourself.
* **Tech stack & domain experience:** You are comfortable with .NET, Angular, SQL Server, Azure, and modern CI/CD practices. Experience with financial, accounting, or ERP systems—as well as European regulatory compliance—is a strong differentiator.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

**Our recruitment process**
---------------------------

1️⃣ A 45' first call with Marc (Talent Acquisition Specialist) to get to know you better and share more about Ageras.

2️⃣ A 90' Technical Interview with one of our Domain Engineers to dive into Architecture and Coding topics

3️⃣ A 45' Manager interview with Rui (Senior Engineering Manager) to dive deeper into our set up.

4️⃣ A 60' Practical Assessment with one of our Domain Engineer.
